name: autoflow
description: Dropshipping outbound sales workflow automation workspace

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run package:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=frontend && npm run test --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace=frontend
scripts.ci:local: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build && npm run test:prod-smoke && npm run audit:prod
